--- a/src/normalize_labels.py
+++ b/src/normalize_labels.py
@@ -1,2 +1,45 @@
 def normalize_labels(value: str) -> list[str]:
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    labels: list[str] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    characters: list[str] = []
+    quoted = False
+    escaped = False
+    pending_space = False
+
+    def finish_label() -> None:
+        label = "".join(characters)
+        if label and label not in seen:
+            seen.add(label)
+            labels.append(label)
+        characters.clear()
+
+    for character in value:
+        if escaped:
+            escaped = False
+        elif character == "\\":
+            escaped = True
+            continue
+        elif character == '"':
+            quoted = not quoted
+            continue
+        elif character == "," and not quoted:
+            finish_label()
+            pending_space = False
+            continue
+        elif character in " \t\r\n\v\f" and not quoted:
+            pending_space = bool(characters)
+            continue
+
+        if pending_space:
+            characters.append(" ")
+            pending_space = False
+        if "A" <= character <= "Z":
+            character = chr(ord(character) + 32)
+        characters.append(character)
+
+    if escaped:
+        raise ValueError("Trailing unpaired backslash")
+    if quoted:
+        raise ValueError("Unclosed double quote")
+    finish_label()
+    return labels
